evidence: The idShape change adds only `@`, `[` and `]` to the allowed characters, and the first character must still be a letter or digit. A YAML plain scalar in block context can contain these characters after its first one, so `model: opus[1m]` and `model: x/model@2025` parse as strings.
Space, quote, backtick, `|` and `,` remain disallowed, so no new way appears to start a comment or end a table cell.
The new test checks that the Claude and Pi artifacts carry the ids verbatim.
The comment edit on the OpenCode column changes no behavior.
